title: UBS: Apple could repurchase $122B through 2019 - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) | Seeking Alpha
text: UBS: Apple could repurchase $122B through 2019 Jan. 8, 2018 3:52 PM ET | About: Apple Inc. (AAPL) | By: Brandy Betz , SA News Editor UBS says Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) could acquire $122B of its own shares through 2019. Analyst Steven Milunovich expects Apple to repatriate around $250B of offshore cash as part of the new U.S. tax plan and says that cash will go towards increasing buybacks. Buy rating and $190 price target reaffirmed. Price target is a 9% upside to Friday’s close.
